7.4 Zero Cost Operation
Zero cost operation is an optimization that may be done where source and destination
modules are single and in source code (one of the modules must be in source code
otherwise the PDU Router must create glue-code for the function call). For example an
ECU with a Com module and a single CAN bus, the PduR_ComTransmit may directly
call the CanIf_Transmit without any logic inside the PduR Module. The PDU Router
becomes a macro layer.
This optimization is only possible where routing paths are of configuration class Pre-
Compile.
[SWS_PduR_00287] ⌈If PduRZeroCostOperation is set to true and all routing
paths are of configuration class Pre-Compile; modules directly above or below the
PDU Router may directly call each other without using PduR module functions.⌋(SRS_-
GTW_06020)
[SWS_PduR_00619] ⌈If PduRZeroCostOperation is set to true and at least one
routing path is not of configuration class Pre-Compile; the PDU Router module con-
figuration generator shall report an error.⌋(SRS_GTW_06020)
